name: Massive (Web Render)
summary: Massive's Web Render API: unblock and render web pages, Google results pages, and ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or AI Overview answers, from chosen locations.

api_token.description: A Massive Web Render API token (dashboard.joinmassive.com). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Not the Polygon.io/Massive market-data key.

notes: This is Massive the proxy network (joinmassive.com), not Polygon.io, which is now also branded Massive and is the polygon vendor.
Prepaid credits, charged only on success: browser and search 1, AI 5, usage reports and account calls free. difficulty medium (2x) or high (6x) and speed ridiculous (2x) multiply the price.
Every call is a GET with query parameters. Live calls usually take seconds but can run up to 3 minutes; mode=async returns an id to read back later with the same endpoint and id=.
A 503 means the service is scaling up; keep the traffic and expect it to clear within a minute.
Residential and ISP proxies and the reseller API are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Render a page
endpoints.summary: A page's rendered HTML, raw HTML or Markdown through an unblocking browser, or a queued render's result.

id.description: The id an async call returned; when given every other parameter is ignored. Either id or url is required.

difficulty.description: Pool to access the URL from. Default low.

speed.description: light (default) or ridiculous, about 30% faster at 2x the credits.

device.description: A device name to emulate, from GET /browser/devices.

captcha.description: What to do with a captcha: solved (default), ignored, or rejected (answer 403).

readiness.description: Page event to wait for before the snapshot. Default load.

delay.description: Extra seconds to wait before the snapshot.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code; random by default.

subdivision.description: Second part of an ISO first-level subdivision code (e.g. CA for US-CA); needs country.

city.description: City name as commonly spelled (case sensitive for now); needs country.

mode.description: sync (default) or async, which returns {id} at once; read the result later by calling again with id.

expiration.description: Days before a cached result counts as expired; 0 disables the cache. Default 1.

endpoints.name: Get Google results pages
endpoints.summary: Live Google results pages, organic and paid, as rendered HTML, or a queued search's result.

id.description: The id an async call returned; when given every other parameter is ignored. Either id or terms is required.

terms.description: Words or a quoted phrase, up to 255 characters.

language.description: Language to search in: name, ISO code or Google code.

uule.description: Google UULE string to emulate a location.

device.description: A device name to emulate, from GET /search/devices.

url.description: A full Google results URL to fetch instead; overrides the other search parameters.

awaiting.description: Lazy features to wait for: ai (AI overview, up to 1 minute), answers (People also ask), ads.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code; random by default.

subdivision.description: Second part of an ISO first-level subdivision code (e.g. CA for US-CA); needs country.

city.description: City name as commonly spelled (case sensitive for now); needs country.

mode.description: sync (default) or async, which returns {id} at once; read the result later by calling again with id.

expiration.description: Days before a cached result counts as expired; 0 disables the cache. Default 1.

notes: Returns HTML, not JSON: several pages are separated by an empty line. Parse it yourself.

endpoints.name: Ask an AI assistant
endpoints.summary: What ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Google's AI Overview answers a prompt, as JSON, or a queued conversation's result.

id.description: The id an async call returned; when given every other parameter is ignored. Either id or prompt is required.

prompt.example: Summarize the latest research on prolonged fasting.

device.description: A device name to emulate, from GET /ai/devices.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code; random by default.

subdivision.description: Second part of an ISO first-level subdivision code (e.g. CA for US-CA); needs country.

city.description: City name as commonly spelled (case sensitive for now); needs country.

mode.description: sync (default) or async, which returns {id} at once; read the result later by calling again with id.

expiration.description: Days before a cached result counts as expired; 0 disables the cache. Default 1.

notes: 5 credits per successful call; prefer mode=async for long answers.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: The account's email and remaining credits.
